newsitem.title: HONG KONG: JAL, MAS launch Penang-Japan 747F.
newsitem.headline: JAL, MAS launch Penang-Japan 747F.

text.p: Japan Airlines Ltd and Malaysia Airlines Systems Bhd are to start joint freighter flights between Penang and Narita and Kansai, JAL said on Thursday.
The once weekly flight from each of the Japanese gateways will start on January 14 using an MAS Boeing 747-200 freighter, it added in a statement.
JAL said these are the first direct, scheduled freighter operations by JAL to Penang which becomes the fifth point in Asia to be served by scheduled JAL all-cargo flights.
The other destinations are Hong Kong, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok. The same freighter will operate connecting services to Kuala Lumpur, the statement added.
With the new services, JAL's weekly freighter services to Malaysia will total seven per week -- five using JAL aircraft and two as joint operations with MAS.

The statement added JAL and MAS plan to work closely together in more joint operations to cope with expanding demand into and out of Malaysia. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
